name: Sacramento headquarters campus
geometry_basis: Local metric design frame: x east, y north; no geographic transform or cadastral claim. 240 × 200 m illustrative envelope within approved 8–15 acre range.

assumptions.statement: Education and 46 short-stay rooms are modelled within the integrated Sacramento campus for this planning option; existing Education location and actual occupancy remain unestablished.
All room counts, dimensions, seats and attendance below are design assumptions; no current employee count, appropriation, construction or commissioning is inferred.
Two protected stairs per occupied multi-storey block, a lift and stacked wet/service cores are concept requirements; detailed fire, structure, accessibility and MEP engineering are unverified.
All modelled staff are anonymous attendance places, not appointments. Visitors, trainee residents and meeting occupants move between rooms; seat sums are not a campus population.

Campus hosts local edge/communications only. Primary production and Alexandria compute use third-party colocation direction; PR119 provider and owned-facility detail remains a separate pending workline.

access.parking_basis: Illustrative 420-person education-event campus peak ×55% car arrival /1.2 persons per vehicle ≈193; 200 spaces reserved. 20% shuttle,15% transit,10% cycle/walk. Availability and mode shares unverified.

adjacency.reason: CEO/Board access to substantive corporate officers; Audit separately controlled.
J2 outside ESS; no pass-through into restricted J2.
Residential learners can reach classes without crossing delivery yard.
Shared teaching does not grant J2 access.
After-hours and equipment access separated from visitors.
